intent.name: SHIFTBY_WEBSITE_IMPLEMENTATION_INTENT_V1
intent.summary: Materialize the ShiftBy website implementation intent into a governed workpacket structure for controlled execution without starting implementation.
intent.primary_intent: Materialize SHIFTBY_WEBSITE_IMPLEMENTATION_INTENT_V1 into a governed workpacket structure for controlled implementation.

operating_mode_expectations: Work must proceed through bounded phases with no auto progression.
Design authority is read-only and implementation must not reinterpret approved designs.
Validation evidence is proof of conformance.
This control-plane creation step is scaffolding only and must not start implementation.
workstream_expectations: Assess repository readiness before architecture work.
Establish implementation architecture before design system work.
Materialize reusable design components before full page implementation.
Add SEO and LLM discoverability without rewriting doctrine language.
Validate with explicit evidence before release readiness review.
goals: Create a governed implementation control plane under plan/impl.
Preserve doctrine, narrative sequence, design fidelity, and execution boundaries.
Define executable phases, statuses, validation rules, and failure handling.
objectives: Create machine-readable implementation authority and intent files.
Create validation and failure classification models.
Create phase directories and phase-specific plan/status scaffolding.
Initialize execution state at phase0 only.

included: Status, authority, validation, and failure models

invariants: Implementation must not reinterpret approved designs.
AI remains a manifestation of the challenge, not the website thesis.
Generated artifacts are derived from approved authority.
validation_expectations: Validate doctrine fidelity against approved doctrine.
Validate narrative fidelity against approved sequence and page intent.
Validate design parity against read-only design authority.
Validate responsiveness, accessibility, SEO, sitemap, robots, llms.txt, structured data, performance, and Core Web Vitals.
Produce evidence with tested condition, expected outcome, actual outcome, blockers, and pass state.
generated_artifact_expectations: Generated website assets are derived artifacts.
Generated artifacts must not become upstream authority.
No generated artifacts are created during this control-plane step.
seo_and_llm_expectations: SEO and answer-engine discoverability must support approved topics including AI strategy, AI adoption, Enterprise AI, AI readiness, Responsible AI, AI governance, AI risk management, AI assurance, AI operating model, AI agents, Knowledge management, Enterprise knowledge graph, and Human-AI collaboration.
SEO language must not replace doctrine language.
Citation-friendly, crawlable, static-first structures are expected in later implementation phases.
human_review_expectations: Human release review is required before production readiness.
Validation evidence must be complete before release readiness review.
Phase6 does not self-approve release readiness.
final_intended_outcome: A governed, evidence-driven ShiftBy website implementation process that preserves doctrine, narrative, and design authority from initial assessment through human-reviewed release readiness.
